verdict.rationale: Plaid's docs describe getting API keys by signing up in the Dashboard and then cloning a runnable Quickstart app. The free, fully featured Sandbox supports unlimited test Items, and a Sandbox-only /sandbox/public_token/create endpoint lets you create a linked account without going through Link. An official Node client library (plaid-node) is evidenced on GitHub. Missing for 10: evidence of client libraries in languages beyond Node, and independent or hands-on corroboration of how fast signup to first linked Sandbox account actually is.
